admission.justification: The selected current Node line and the evidence condition for using24 constrain later runtime changes; an unrelated native tool gap must not silently select an older runtime.

alternatives.option: Select the newest Node26 release for the host build.
alternatives.reason: The developer selected the current line; the sandbox host and bridge work on26 and an offered Pi agent replies. The same native startup refusal occurs on the matched22 control.

alternatives.option: Select the newest Node24 release if the host fails on26.
alternatives.reason: The authorized fallback requires a failure attributable to the host on26; the matched startup gap supplies no such evidence.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A controlled witness establishes that the host fails on26 and the failure is absent on the matched control.

alternatives.option: Keep Node22 if both selected newer lines fail.
alternatives.reason: Retaining the previous line is only the packet fallback after both newer host attempts fail; no such failure occurred.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Both authorized newer Node host attempts fail with retained attributable evidence.

consequences: The packaged contract pins26.11.1 and its verified archive. A common startup tool refusal does not activate24. Provisioning the developer installation remains a separate post-landing action owned by the Architect.
context: The host build must move from its old Node pin to the current release while the operational witness distinguishes a Node failure from an unrelated startup tool gap.
